claims.text: The number of clusters was varied in the experiments, with optimal results generally obtained between 250 and 1000 clusters.
Different types of word embeddings were evaluated, including skip-gram, cbow, and GloVe, but no clear winner was identified among them.
The experiments also considered the dimensionality of the embeddings, suggesting low dimensionality for skip-gram embeddings as a starting point.
